parameters.name: Code
parameters.description: The code of the publish flow stage. For the specific value, see the response of the GetPipelineRun operation.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the publish flow.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace settings page to obtain the workspace ID.
